voice.text: 欢迎来到引力实验室。请选择自由体验，或关卡挑战。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 请缓慢环顾四周。看看地面、桌面，还有墙面。确认扫描范围后，点击继续。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 扫描完成，空间已锁定。现在，可以在平面上绘制虫洞了。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 按住扳机，或保持抓捏。画出一个闭合的轮廓。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 虫洞已就绪。引力场稳定。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 选一个物体吧。确认洞口足够大，再点击发射。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 发射成功。看看它会怎样穿过虫洞。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 闭环建立成功。物体正在稳定循环。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 检测到碰撞，实验已停止。准备好后，再试一次。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 按住握持键，就能在当前平面内移动虫洞。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 对准虫洞。按住手柄的 B 键，或 Y 键，两秒后删除。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: 当前平面不可用。请重新扫描周围的空间。
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Welcome to the Gravity Lab. Choose free play, or a mission challenge.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Take a slow look around. Scan the floor, tables, and walls. When you are ready, select continue.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Scan complete. Your surfaces are now locked. You can start drawing portals.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Hold the trigger, or keep pinching. Draw a closed outline.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Portal ready. The gravitational field is stable.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Choose an object. Make sure it fits the portals, then select launch.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Launch successful. Watch it travel through your portals.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: You have made a stable loop. The object is circulating smoothly.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: There was a collision. The experiment has stopped. Try again when you are ready.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Hold the grip button to move a portal along its current surface.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: Point at a portal. Hold the B button, or the Y button, for two seconds to delete it.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

voice.text: This surface is no longer available. Please scan your surroundings again.
voice.engine: Microsoft Edge neural TTS via edge-tts

notes: SFX are mono emitters for later PICO Spatial Audio placement.
Distance attenuation and HRTF require runtime integration; stereo preview is not proof of spatial playback.
SFX are locally synthesized. Narration is offline neural speech, refreshed in 1.0.6; voice quality awaits user listening feedback.

voiceDesign.direction: Calm, natural laboratory guide; female neural voices, restrained warmth, short phrases; no vocoder or metallic echo.
voiceDesign.delivery: Offline mono PCM; no network or speech SDK at runtime.
